text: Could you make a water-cycle explainer with a friendly voice-over that you write? I always find this process easier to understand when I can actually watch it happen. What I mean is, show water rising, then clouds forming, then rain, and make it 10 seconds long in widescreen. For those stages, use the exact labels “Evaporation”, “Condensation”, and “Precipitation”, in that order. I’m probably over-explaining because I worry about getting the stages mixed up. Please don’t put any other text on screen.
